subject: reasoning
question:
Which of the following will come next to the series?

P, H, D, B, ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/87194c20cacd5afe0038482a050cac21a5b59d88d71a4824aab2fad4447d1474.png] 

Given series: **P, H, D, B, ?**

The logic followed here is:

16 ÷ 2 = 8 ÷ 2 = 4 ÷ 2 = 2 ÷ 2 = 1

Position 1 = A

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4ba3f540d958a28491eb7abb4212a23bcafdbc4a56fa3bfcb9931a6bd879940f.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/367746a49409a9f2dad2ae738e7ecd668061df89b6c0192dae55d154c3a09ab4.png] 

Thus, the missing term in the series is A

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1"
